caption: The drawing depicts a simple object composed primarily of two colors: brown and blue. The main structure is a vertical brown pole with a rounded top and is shown with a series of evenly spaced circular holes running down its center. Attached near the top of this pole, perpendicularly, is a horizontal blue rectangular piece, fixed to the vertical pole with a visible blue fastener or screw at the point of attachment. The base of the object features a brown, semi-circular platform or tray that is attached to the bottom of the vertical pole, creating a shallow, open-fronted container. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or features present.
title: Shaker Candle Stand
